My name is Justin Mascarenhas and I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from RIT. I came across LuminX's Robotics Systems Engineer opening and wanted to reach out since it sits in the engineering org you lead.

The role lines up closely with what I have already built. I put vision models on NVIDIA Jetson with TensorRT so they run fast in real time, set up a multi camera capture pipeline, and got a robot picking parts reliably by working through the messy failures where software meets hardware. I am comfortable in Linux, Python, and C++, and I enjoy the hands on hardware side too.

Would you be open to a short conversation about the role?
